scope.remaining_dimensions: Largest absolute reference BF16 values excluding fixed indices; ties use ascending dimension; reference NaNs rank first, then infinities.
scope.comparison: Actual captured post-layer BF16 hidden against the pinned independent nominal reference; final layer uses actual stage-output rows.
scope.relative_error: abs(actual-reference)/abs(reference) when both finite and reference!=0; both zero gives0; nonzero actual with zero reference or any nonfinite value gives null and relative_undefined=true.
scope.nonfinite_values: Reported individually among the selected 1000; no claim of a numeric pass.
scope.checkpoint_preservation: File, identity and byte integrity only; no Restore neural/control value validation.
